title: Find Slope from Graphs Core Test
description: Find slope on coordinate graphs by using rise over run between two points on a line.

questions.questionText: On a coordinate graph, a line passes through (0, -2) and (4, 1). What is the slope?
questions.explanation: Use rise over run: slope = change in y divided by change in x.
